## Services
- Year-round lawn maintenance: Mowing, edging, trimming and blowing on a regular schedule, so the yard looks sharp every week of the year.
- Leaf & seasonal cleanups: Fall leaves, spring cleanups and overgrown yards cleared out, even while you're out of town.
- Mulch & bed cleanups: Overgrown beds cut back, cleared and finished with a fresh layer of mulch.
- Gravel, edging & walkways: Black gravel beds with steel edging and stepping-stone walkways that stay clean and low-maintenance.
- Sod & plantings: New sod laid and watered in, plus shrub plantings, turning the worst yard on the block into one of the best.
- Holiday & tree lighting: Rooflines traced and tree trunks wrapped in lights for homes and event venues.

## About
Marathon Lawn Care & Services is an owner-run lawn crew based in North Austin, off Everest Lane in 78727. Zach and the team take care of homes and properties across Austin and Cedar Park, Monday through Friday, all year long. Customers talk about the same things again and again: the crew is thorough, Zach is an excellent communicator, and visits happen when they're supposed to. If severe weather gets in the way, Zach lets you know and reschedules promptly. Need an estimate while you're away? Zach can get one to you fast, the crew takes care of the job once you approve it, and you can pay the invoice remotely. Come home to a yard that looks great.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you offer year-round lawn maintenance?
  A: Yes. Year-round maintenance is our core service: regular mowing, edging, trimming and cleanup through every season in Austin and Cedar Park.
- Q: What happens if it rains on my service day?
  A: We keep you posted. If severe weather gets in the way, Zach lets you know and reschedules promptly, so you don't miss a service.
- Q: Can I get an estimate if I'm not home?
  A: Yes. Zach can send an estimate quickly while you're away. Once you approve it, the crew takes care of the job and you can pay the invoice remotely.
- Q: What areas do you serve?
  A: We're based in North Austin (78727) and work across Austin and Cedar Park, including Wells Branch, Round Rock, Pflugerville and Anderson Mill. Call to check your address.
- Q: Do you install sod, mulch and gravel beds?
  A: Yes. We install sod, refresh mulch beds, and build gravel beds with steel edging and stepping-stone walkways.
- Q: Do you hang holiday lights?
  A: Yes, on rooflines and trees. Call (512) 589-8363.
